name: Get Instagram API Docs
name_zh: 获取 Instagram API 文档
summary: Get complete documentation for all implemented Instagram REST APIs in OpenHub, enabling ClawBot to automatically discover available interfaces.
summary_zh: 获取 OpenHub 所有已实现 Instagram REST API 的完整说明文档,供 ClawBot 自动发现接口。
description: Resource model: Instagram API documentation collection. Returns the collection of Instagram domain REST API documentation currently exposed by OpenHub, allowing clawbot to automatically discover Instagram interaction capabilities. Returns 200 and documentation array on success; returns 500 on failure.
description_zh: 资源模型:Instagram API documentation collection。返回当前 OpenHub 对外暴露的 Instagram 域 REST API 文档集合,供 clawbot 自动发现与 Instagram 交互相关的能力。成功时返回 200 和文档数组;失败时返回 500。

name: Get Connected Instances
name_zh: 获取已连接实例
summary: Query all tweetClaw instances currently connected to OpenHub via WebSocket, used for routing selection in multi-profile Instagram scenarios.
summary_zh: 查询当前所有通过 WebSocket 连接到 OpenHub 的 tweetClaw 实例，用于 Instagram 多 Profile 场景下的路由选择。
description: Resource model: LocalBridge instance collection. This endpoint returns a list of all currently online tweetClaw browser extension instances. Each instance corresponds to one browser profile and can serve accounts across multiple platforms within that profile, including Instagram. The URI uses /api/v1/instances, expressing a global instance resource collection; the HTTP method uses GET, semantically for reading. Returns 200 OK and instance array on success; returns 500 on failure. Return fields include instanceId, instanceName, clientName, clientVersion, connection time, last active time and other metadata. Callers can attach the required instanceId to subsequent Instagram-related operations to achieve precise multi-account routing control. If the extension version is older (without stable instanceId), isTemporary will be marked as true.
description_zh: 资源模型：LocalBridge 实例集合。该接口返回当前所有在线的 tweetClaw 浏览器扩展实例列表。每个实例对应一个浏览器 Profile，并可同时承载该 Profile 下多个平台的账号，包括 Instagram。URI 使用 /api/v1/instances，表达“全局实例资源集合”；HTTP 方法使用 GET，语义为读取。成功时返回 200 OK 和实例数组；失败时返回 500。返回字段包括 instanceId、instanceName、clientName、clientVersion、连接时间、最后活跃时间等元数据，调用方可将所需的 instanceId 附加到后续 Instagram 相关操作中，实现精准的多账号路由控制。若扩展版本较旧（未携带稳定 instanceId），isTemporary 会标记为 true。

name: Get Instagram Self Info
name_zh: 获取 Instagram 账号信息
summary: Get the current logged-in Instagram account information, including user ID, username, full name, follower count, and other profile data.
summary_zh: 获取当前登录的 Instagram 账号信息,包括用户 ID、用户名、全名、粉丝数等个人资料数据。
description: Returns the complete raw response from Instagram's user self-info API. Contains pk (user ID), username, full_name, profile_pic_url, follower_count, following_count, media_count, and other fields. This is the first step for AI to perceive account state. No data preprocessing; completely passes through the raw Instagram API response.
description_zh: 返回 Instagram 用户信息 API 的完整原始响应。包含 pk(用户 ID)、username、full_name、profile_pic_url、follower_count、following_count、media_count 等字段。是 AI 感知账号状态的第一步。完全透传 Instagram API 原始响应。

name: Get Instagram Feed
name_zh: 获取 Instagram 主页推荐
summary: Get the home feed from Instagram with pagination support.
summary_zh: 获取 Instagram 主页信息流,支持分页。
description: Fetches the home feed from Instagram with pagination support via cursor parameter. Returns a list of posts with details including post ID, shortcode, caption, media type (image/video), owner info, like count, comment count, and timestamp. Useful for content discovery and feed monitoring.
description_zh: 从 Instagram 获取主页信息流,支持通过 cursor 参数分页。返回帖子列表,包含帖子 ID、shortcode、标题、媒体类型(图片/视频)、作者信息、点赞数、评论数和时间戳。适用于内容发现和信息流监控。

name: Get Instagram User Info
name_zh: 获取 Instagram 用户信息
summary: Get detailed profile information for a specific Instagram user by user ID.
summary_zh: 通过用户 ID 获取指定 Instagram 用户的详细资料信息。
description: Fetches public profile information for any Instagram user. Requires user_id parameter. Returns user details including username, full_name, profile_pic_url, biography, follower/following counts, media count, and verification status. Essential for user research and relationship building.
description_zh: 获取任意 Instagram 用户的公开资料信息。需要 user_id 参数。返回用户详情,包括 username(用户名)、full_name(全名)、profile_pic_url(头像)、biography(简介)、粉丝/关注数、发布数和认证状态。是用户研究和关系建立的基础。

name: Get Instagram Media Detail
name_zh: 获取 Instagram 媒体详情
summary: Get detailed information about a specific Instagram post, including content, images/videos, and interaction data.
summary_zh: 获取指定 Instagram 帖子的详细信息,包括内容、图片/视频和互动数据。
description: Fetches complete details of a specific post from Instagram. Requires media_id or shortcode parameter. Returns post content (caption), media URLs (images/videos), owner info, like count, comment count, and timestamp. Essential for content analysis and interaction decisions.
description_zh: 获取 Instagram 指定帖子的完整详情。需要 media_id 或 shortcode 参数。返回帖子内容(标题)、媒体 URL(图片/视频)、作者信息、点赞数、评论数和时间戳。是内容分析和互动决策的基础。

name: Get Instagram Media Comments
name_zh: 获取 Instagram 媒体评论
summary: Get comments for a specific Instagram post, including nested replies.
summary_zh: 获取指定 Instagram 帖子的评论,包括嵌套回复。
description: Fetches the comment thread for a specific post. Requires media_id parameter. Supports cursor-based pagination via min_id parameter. Optional sort_order parameter controls sorting (popular/chronological). Returns comments with user info, text, timestamps, like counts, and nested reply information. Essential for community engagement analysis and automated reply scenarios.
description_zh: 获取指定帖子的评论线程。需要 media_id 参数。支持通过 min_id 参数进行基于游标的分页。可选的 sort_order 参数控制排序(热门/时间)。返回评论包含用户信息、文本、时间戳、点赞数和嵌套回复信息。是社区互动分析和自动回复场景的核心功能。

name: Search Instagram
name_zh: 搜索 Instagram 内容
summary: Search for content on Instagram by keyword, with pagination support.
summary_zh: 通过关键词搜索 Instagram 内容,支持分页。
description: Performs keyword search on Instagram's content database. Requires query parameter in request body. Supports pagination via after/before cursors and first/last parameters. Returns a list of matching posts with summary info. Essential for content discovery, trend monitoring, and competitive analysis.
description_zh: 在 Instagram 内容数据库中执行关键词搜索。需要请求体中的 query 参数。支持通过 after/before 游标和 first/last 参数分页。返回匹配帖子列表及摘要信息。是内容发现、趋势监控和竞品分析的核心功能。

name: Search Instagram Users
name_zh: 搜索 Instagram 用户
summary: Search for Instagram users by keyword.
summary_zh: 通过关键词搜索 Instagram 用户。
description: Searches for users on Instagram by keyword. Requires query parameter. Returns a list of matching users with their user_id, username, full_name, profile_pic_url, and follower count. Essential for finding users to interact with or mention.
description_zh: 在 Instagram 搜索用户。需要 query 参数。返回匹配用户列表,包含 user_id、username(用户名)、full_name(全名)、profile_pic_url(头像)和粉丝数。是查找用户进行互动或提及的基础功能。

name: Get Instagram Notifications
name_zh: 获取 Instagram 消息通知
summary: Get notification messages from Instagram, including comments, likes, follows, and mentions.
summary_zh: 获取 Instagram 的消息通知,包括评论、点赞、关注和提及。
description: Fetches notification data from Instagram. Returns notification list with details including type, user info, media info, and timestamp. Supports pagination via max_id parameter. Types include: comments, likes, follows, mentions. Essential for monitoring account engagement and responding to user interactions.
description_zh: 获取 Instagram 通知数据。返回通知详情列表,包括类型、用户信息、媒体信息和时间戳。支持通过 max_id 参数分页。类型包括:评论、点赞、关注、提及。是监控账号互动和响应用户交互的核心功能。

name: Get Instagram User Media
name_zh: 获取 Instagram 用户发布内容
summary: Get the list of posts published by a specific Instagram user, with pagination support.
summary_zh: 获取指定 Instagram 用户发布的帖子列表,支持分页。
description: Fetches all public posts from a specific user's profile. Requires user_id parameter. Optional parameters: username (alternative to user_id), count (number of posts, default 12), after (pagination cursor). Returns paginated list of posts with thumbnails, captions, and interaction stats. Useful for analyzing user content strategy and engagement patterns.
description_zh: 获取指定用户主页的所有公开帖子。需要 user_id 参数。可选参数:username(user_id 的替代)、count(帖子数量,默认 12)、after(分页游标)。返回分页的帖子列表,包含缩略图、标题和互动统计。适用于分析用户内容策略和互动模式。

name: Get Instagram Followers
name_zh: 获取 Instagram 粉丝列表
summary: Get the followers list for a specific Instagram user, with pagination support.
summary_zh: 获取指定 Instagram 用户的粉丝列表,支持分页。
description: Fetches the followers list for a specific user. Requires user_id parameter. Supports cursor-based pagination via max_id parameter. Optional count parameter specifies number of users per page (default 12). Returns user list with username, full_name, profile_pic_url, and follower counts. Essential for audience analysis and relationship building.
description_zh: 获取指定用户的粉丝列表。需要 user_id 参数。支持通过 max_id 参数进行基于游标的分页。可选的 count 参数指定每页用户数(默认 12)。返回用户列表,包含 username、full_name、profile_pic_url 和粉丝数。是受众分析和关系建立的核心功能。

name: Get Instagram Following
name_zh: 获取 Instagram 关注列表
summary: Get the following list for a specific Instagram user, with pagination support.
summary_zh: 获取指定 Instagram 用户的关注列表,支持分页。
description: Fetches the following list for a specific user. Requires user_id parameter. Supports cursor-based pagination via max_id parameter. Optional count parameter specifies number of users per page (default 12). Returns user list with username, full_name, profile_pic_url, and follower counts. Essential for relationship analysis and network mapping.
description_zh: 获取指定用户的关注列表。需要 user_id 参数。支持通过 max_id 参数进行基于游标的分页。可选的 count 参数指定每页用户数(默认 12)。返回用户列表,包含 username、full_name、profile_pic_url 和粉丝数。是关系分析和网络映射的核心功能。

name: Post Instagram Image
name_zh: 发布 Instagram 图片
summary: Publish a new image post on Instagram with caption.
summary_zh: 在 Instagram 发布新图片帖子，包含标题。
description: Publishes a new image post to Instagram. Requires image_base64 (base64-encoded image) and caption in request body. Optional: disable_comments (boolean), share_to_threads (boolean). Upload process: 1) upload image to Instagram CDN via rupload_igphoto, 2) configure post metadata. Returns media object with id and shortcode on success. Rate limiting applies.
description_zh: 在 Instagram 发布新图片帖子。需要 image_base64（base64 编码图片）和 caption。可选：disable_comments（禁用评论）、share_to_threads（分享到 Threads）。发布流程：1) 上传图片到 Instagram CDN（rupload_igphoto）；2) 配置帖子元数据。成功返回含 id 和 shortcode 的 media 对象。有频率限制。

name: Post Instagram Video (Chunked Task API)
name_zh: 发布 Instagram 视频（分片 Task API）
summary: Publish a large video as an Instagram Reel using the Task API chunked upload protocol. Bypasses the 64 MiB Chrome message size limit.
summary_zh: 通过 Task API 分片上传协议将大视频发布为 Instagram Reel，绕过 Chrome 64 MiB 消息限制。
description: Publishes a video to Instagram Clips (Reels) via the LocalBridge Task API. Because Chrome extension messages are capped at 64 MiB, video data is split into chunks (≤10 MB each) and uploaded separately before the task starts. Full flow: 1) Create task (POST /api/v1/tasks/create, task_kind=ig.publish_video, input_mode=chunked_binary); 2) Upload chunks (POST /api/v1/tasks/{id}/chunks, one part per call); 3) Seal input (POST /api/v1/tasks/{id}/seal, total_parts+total_bytes+content_type); 4) Start task (POST /api/v1/tasks/{id}/start) — background SW fetches chunks, content script performs rupload_igvideo chunked upload (10 MB IG chunks), uploads thumbnail, then polls configure_to_clips until transcode finishes; 5) Poll status (GET /api/v1/tasks/{id}/status); 6) Get result (GET /api/v1/tasks/{id}/result). Task params: caption (string), videoDuration (ms), videoWidth, videoHeight, disableComments (bool), shareToThreads (bool), thumbnailBase64 (optional base64 JPEG/PNG). Returns full IG media object including id, shortcode, and Reel URL. Typical latency: ~5 min for a 20 MB video.
description_zh: 通过 LocalBridge Task API 将视频发布到 Instagram Clips（Reels）。由于 Chrome 扩展消息上限为 64 MiB，视频数据先分片（每片 ≤10 MB）上传，再由 background SW 驱动 content script 执行实际上传。完整流程：1) 创建 Task（POST /api/v1/tasks/create，task_kind=ig.publish_video，input_mode=chunked_binary）；2) 分片上传（POST /api/v1/tasks/{id}/chunks，每次上传一片）；3) 封装输入（POST /api/v1/tasks/{id}/seal，携带 total_parts/total_bytes/content_type）；4) 启动任务（POST /api/v1/tasks/{id}/start）—— background SW 拉取分片，content script 执行 rupload_igvideo 10 MB 分片上传、上传封面图，再轮询 configure_to_clips 直到转码完成；5) 轮询状态（GET /api/v1/tasks/{id}/status）；6) 获取结果（GET /api/v1/tasks/{id}/result）。Task params：caption、videoDuration（毫秒）、videoWidth、videoHeight、disableComments、shareToThreads、thumbnailBase64（可选 base64 JPEG/PNG）。返回完整 IG media 对象，含 id、shortcode 和 Reel URL。典型耗时：20 MB 视频约 5 分钟。
curl:
# Step 1: Create task
curl -X POST http://127.0.0.1:10088/api/v1/tasks/create -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"clientName":"tweetClaw","instanceId":"<instance_id>","taskKind":"ig.publish_video","inputMode":"chunked_binary","params":{"caption":"My video","videoDuration":10000,"videoWidth":1920,"videoHeight":1080,"disableComments":false,"shareToThreads":true}}'
# Step 2: Upload chunks (repeat for each chunk)
curl -X POST http://127.0.0.1:10088/api/v1/tasks/<task_id>/chunks -H 'Content-Type: application/octet-stream' -H 'X-Part-Index: 0' --data-binary @chunk0.bin
# Step 3: Seal
curl -X POST http://127.0.0.1:10088/api/v1/tasks/<task_id>/seal -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"totalParts":3,"totalBytes":22229350,"contentType":"video/mp4"}'
# Step 4: Start
curl -X POST http://127.0.0.1:10088/api/v1/tasks/<task_id>/start
# Step 5: Poll status
curl http://127.0.0.1:10088/api/v1/tasks/<task_id>/status
# Step 6: Get result
curl http://127.0.0.1:10088/api/v1/tasks/<task_id>/result

name: Like Instagram Media
name_zh: 点赞 Instagram 媒体
summary: Like a specific Instagram post to show appreciation.
summary_zh: 点赞指定的 Instagram 帖子。
description: Likes a specific post on Instagram. Requires media_id parameter in request body. Uses GraphQL mutation for the operation. Returns success status. Rate limiting applies with 3-8 seconds delay recommended between consecutive likes. Essential for engagement automation.
description_zh: 点赞 Instagram 指定帖子。需要请求体中的 media_id 参数。使用 GraphQL mutation 执行操作。返回成功状态。有频率限制,建议连续点赞间隔 3-8 秒。是互动自动化的核心功能。

name: Unlike Instagram Media
name_zh: 取消点赞 Instagram 媒体
summary: Remove a like from a previously liked Instagram post.
summary_zh: 取消之前点赞的 Instagram 帖子。
description: Removes a like from a previously liked post on Instagram. Requires media_id parameter in request body. Uses GraphQL mutation for the operation. Returns success status. Rate limiting applies. Useful for correcting accidental likes or managing engagement history.
description_zh: 取消 Instagram 之前点赞的帖子。需要请求体中的 media_id 参数。使用 GraphQL mutation 执行操作。返回成功状态。有频率限制。适用于纠正误点赞或管理互动历史。

name: Post Instagram Comment
name_zh: 发布 Instagram 评论
summary: Post a comment or reply on an Instagram post.
summary_zh: 在 Instagram 帖子发布评论或回复。
description: Posts a new comment or reply on an Instagram post. Requires media_id and comment_text in request body. For replying to an existing comment, include replied_to_comment_id (parent comment ID). Returns comment_id on success. Note: Rate limiting applies; wait 3-8 seconds between consecutive comments.
description_zh: 在 Instagram 帖子发布新评论或回复。需要请求体中的 media_id 和 comment_text。回复现有评论时需包含 replied_to_comment_id(父评论 ID)。成功时返回 comment_id。注意:有频率限制,连续评论需等待 3-8 秒。

name: Delete Instagram Comment
name_zh: 删除 Instagram 评论
summary: Delete a comment posted by the current account on an Instagram post.
summary_zh: 删除当前账号在 Instagram 帖子上发布的评论。
description: Deletes a comment posted by the current account. Requires both media_id and comment_id parameters in request body. Returns success status. This is a write operation; use with caution. Useful for content moderation and error correction.
description_zh: 删除当前账号发布的评论。需要请求体中的 media_id 和 comment_id 两个参数。返回成功状态。这是写操作;请谨慎使用。适用于内容审核和错误纠正。

name: Follow Instagram User
name_zh: 关注 Instagram 用户
summary: Follow a specific Instagram user to subscribe to their content.
summary_zh: 关注指定的 Instagram 用户以订阅其内容。
description: Follows a specific user on Instagram. Requires user_id parameter in request body. Uses GraphQL mutation for the operation. Returns success status. Rate limiting applies with 3-8 seconds delay recommended between consecutive follows. Essential for relationship building and audience expansion.
description_zh: 关注 Instagram 指定用户。需要请求体中的 user_id 参数。使用 GraphQL mutation 执行操作。返回成功状态。有频率限制,建议连续关注间隔 3-8 秒。是关系建立和受众扩展的核心功能。

name: Unfollow Instagram User
name_zh: 取消关注 Instagram 用户
summary: Unfollow a previously followed Instagram user.
summary_zh: 取消之前关注的 Instagram 用户。
description: Unfollows a previously followed user on Instagram. Requires user_id parameter in request body. Uses GraphQL mutation for the operation. Returns success status. Rate limiting applies. Useful for managing following list and account hygiene.
description_zh: 取消 Instagram 之前关注的用户。需要请求体中的 user_id 参数。使用 GraphQL mutation 执行操作。返回成功状态。有频率限制。适用于管理关注列表和账号维护。

name: Delete Instagram Media
name_zh: 删除 Instagram 媒体
summary: Delete a post published by the current account on Instagram.
summary_zh: 删除当前账号在 Instagram 发布的帖子。
description: Deletes a post published by the current account. Requires media_id parameter in request body. Returns success status. This is a destructive operation; use with extreme caution as the action is irreversible. Useful for content management and removing outdated content.
description_zh: 删除当前账号发布的帖子。需要请求体中的 media_id 参数。返回成功状态。这是破坏性操作;请极度谨慎使用,因为操作不可逆。适用于内容管理和移除过时内容。
